text:
Deploy is not confirmed healthy. Image `api:7f3c2e1` was built, pushed, and rolled out to staging, but `/healthz` was still returning 503 when the 60s healthcheck timed out.

I don't know the cause yet. It could be a slow startup that needs more than 60s, or the new build failing (bad config, missing dependency, failed migration or DB connection). The output doesn't distinguish these.

Next, I'd check `kubectl rollout status deployment/api` and the pod logs on staging to see whether the pods are crash-looping or just not ready. If you want, I can do that, or roll back to the previous image.
